task.title: Discover extension manifests deterministically
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/594 by discovering validated manifests from one caller-selected extension root without activating capabilities.
acceptance_criteria: Inspect only immediate child extension.yaml candidates and ignore unrelated or deeper entries.
Return validated manifests in lexicographic path order and fail without a partial result.
Preserve root and candidate failures as typed errors with the failing path and source.
Reject symlinked candidates and fail closed where descriptor-anchored traversal is unavailable.

attempts.summary: Established RED coverage for shallow sorted discovery.
attempts.diagnostic: The manifest crate could load one selected file but had no root discovery API, discovered-extension type, or discovery error contract.
attempts.patch: Added integration tests for sorted candidates, shallow scope, ignored entries, source-preserving failures, symlink rejection, and unsupported-platform behavior.

attempts.diagnostic: Unix directory descriptors and no-follow opens provide deterministic package enumeration without trusting path re-resolution or activating entrypoints.
attempts.patch: Added DiscoveredExtension, discover_extensions, typed errors, bounded reader reuse, Unix rustix traversal, documentation, and milestone evidence.

attempts.summary: Corrected the path attached to child-directory enumeration failures.
attempts.diagnostic: Substantive review found that a non-ignorable child open failure reported only the root, hiding the child that actually failed.
attempts.patch: Added RED coverage for an unreadable child and reported the descriptor-relative child path while preserving the I/O source.

outcome.summary: Vela now discovers one extension root shallowly and deterministically, returning validated metadata or one typed all-or-nothing failure without activation.

verification.command: Substantive exact-head CodeRabbit review and zero unresolved threads at https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/pull/595

lessons: Caller-owned shallow roots avoid hidden configuration and recursive scanning semantics.
Descriptor-relative traversal and no-follow opens keep discovery inside the selected package boundary.
Typed filesystem diagnostics should identify the narrowest path that actually failed.
Discovery remains metadata validation and grants no permission to activate an entrypoint.
